decisions.reason: As the new flagship product line close to the core offer and launched only recently, its value is still unresolved and it fits the firm's digital-practice direction, so the option is worth far more than its low carrying cost.
The training institute complements the established software and support business, keeping it costs little, and it is too early for evidence to show that its value will not be realized.
The remote screen-sharing support tool is a cheap add-on to the existing customer support, is still in early resolution, and supports service efficiency, so there is no reason to abandon the option.
